text:
He opens his mouth,

it is red inside.

She opens her eyes,

her cornea is white

like the moon.


It stays still,

the cornea moon,

barely illuminating

the well-beloved gum.


Inside,

with silence,

with mouth closed,

in the dark,

both dwell.

translation.title: Dialogue
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bodily close-up and the silent interior where both figures dwell.
